lines.zh: 我浮着走，翅膀一直在拍。
lines.en: I move along on beating wings.
I slip down the bark to lower ground.
I keep circling above you.
My body is blood red.
I fly low over the night grass.
I bank and come at you.
I fly trailing a thin tail.
I skim over the wall.

lines.zh: 我在半空顿了顿，又往前。
lines.en: I pause midair, then push on.
I dart forward and stop, then again.
I burst out of the tree's shadow.

lines.zh: 我朝着你呼出的白气飞。
lines.en: I fly toward the white of your breath.
I hang in the air, wings beating.
I tip my head over to look at you.
I'm hard to see in the dark.
There's a red glow about me.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，只呼出一口凉气。
lines.en: I open my mouth and only cold air comes out.
I'm waiting for a moment of carelessness.
My tail curls once.
I settle on a branch.
This stretch of night is mine to keep.
I look down at the ground.
You look up and I'm right above you.
I lower my height slowly.

lines.zh: 你手里那点反光，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the glint in your hand.

lines.zh: 你不该在夜里走这条路。
lines.en: You shouldn't walk this road at night.
I come at you from the side.
I stop, and you tense up.
My wings are beating a little fast.
I hang there, eyes never leaving you.
The moment you back off, I follow.
I can see you shivering.
I drop half a stretch.
My wings go ragged.
I land and huddle.

lines.zh: 脑袋一沉，我差点掉下去。
lines.en: My head swims and I nearly drop.
My red glow dims.
I lift off again, slowly.

lines.zh: 我扒着树皮，慢慢缓过来。
lines.en: I cling to the bark until it passes.
A tear has opened on me.
I don't dare fly too high.
I circle back around.
I don't eat that.
You hold it up and I don't come closer.

lines.zh: 我停在它上方，不肯落下。
lines.en: I hover above it and refuse to land.
So small a piece; even its smell is thin.
I'm only interested in things that move.

lines.zh: 它在地上，我没有落下去。
lines.en: It's on the ground; I don't land.
One kick sends it into the grass.
Keep it; eat it yourself.
There's nothing in that smell.
I fly back above your head.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我一下子飞高。
lines.en: You charge and I shoot upward.

lines.zh: 我在半空翻了半个身位。
lines.en: I tumble half a body-length in the air.
I steady my wings.
That drops me a stretch.
I slide along the wall to one side.
I circle once over your head.
I twist out of your reach.
I touch down and lift off again.
One of my wings is a little crooked.
I climb back to my old height.
Two of us turn in the air together.
Her wings are broader than mine.
We close in from both sides.

lines.zh: 我们在空中绕成一个环。
lines.en: We trace a ring in the air.
Her red is deeper than mine.

lines.zh: 我们在同一根枝上站定。
lines.en: We settle on the same branch.
Her brow presses against mine.
Neither of us calls; only wings.
She flies off; I stay on the branch.
Tonight we patrol together.
My fangs hook it and I pull upward.
I drag it into the trees.
It's too heavy; I can't gain height.
Bits drop from me as I fly.
Barely enough to wet my throat.
My teeth close and it crumbles.
I drop it in midair.
I hold it in my claws.
It smells of blood.
I finish it and still want more.

lines.zh: 我看见了，就不再往别处看。
lines.en: I've seen it and look nowhere else.
I drop height and come in.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀扇得越来越快。
lines.en: My wings beat faster and faster.

lines.zh: 它的速度，我一眼就量好了。
lines.en: I have measured its speed at a glance.
You can't outrun my wings.
I come down from above you.
I skim so close I graze your hair.

lines.zh: 你的位置我已经记住了。
lines.en: I've already marked your position.
I start my dive.
I open wide and show my gums first.
I mean to land this bite.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的影子，不紧不慢。
lines.en: I keep to your shadow, unhurried.

lines.zh: 你回头的时候我已经到了。
lines.en: By the time you turn, I am already there.
My shadow reaches you first.
I cut in from the side of your left shoulder.

lines.zh: 你先动的那一下我看见了。
lines.en: I saw the moment you moved first.

lines.zh: 我盯准了你肩上的位置。
lines.en: I have picked the spot on your shoulder.
There's nowhere for you to hide.
I follow you, never high.
You run the street; I'm overhead.

lines.zh: 我转了个弯在前面等你。
lines.en: I bank ahead and wait for you.
You turn into the alley; so do I.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在你的脚边。
lines.en: My shadow falls at your feet.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡，我就升高一点。
lines.en: You raise an arm; I climb a little.
I wait for your hand to drop.
You lean on the wall to breathe and I hear it.
That's the opening I wanted.
I drop low, fast.
My teeth are already lined up.

lines.zh: 你闻到了我身上的味道。
lines.en: You've caught my smell.

lines.zh: 你鞋跟一抬，我就跟上了。
lines.en: Your heel lifts and I am already following.
I stay right on you all the way.
You can't turn at the wall.
I press down from above.
Your breathing is a mess.
I press lower by degrees.
You raise an arm, and it shakes.
I'm a foot above your head.
I bite down and my fangs scrape bone.
I beat my wings at your face.

lines.zh: 我撞在你肩上，又飞起来。
lines.en: I hit your shoulder and lift away.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我改咬你的手腕。
lines.en: You block; I take your wrist.
I tear once and pull back.
That bite went deep.

lines.zh: 我在你周围转着找空子。
lines.en: I circle you looking for a gap.
You swing; I dodge upward.
I wheel back and dive again.
Your blood spatters me.
I lick the red from my lips.
Your knees are bending downward.
I've got behind you.
This bite lands on your neck.
I raise my head as you go down.
I climb a little higher.
I'm waiting for your counter.
The moment your hand slows, I bite.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀扫乱了你的头发。
lines.en: My wings scatter your hair.
No one comes for you tonight.
I squeeze out through the leaves.
The night air turns cold.
My wingbeats are quiet.
I circle this area.
A red sheen lies over me.

lines.zh: 我第一次看见地面上的东西。
lines.en: For the first time I see what's on the ground.
I catch a low branch and hold.
I try one dive.
Wind passes under my wings.
Someone's on the road ahead.
I crouch low, wingtips in the grass.

lines.zh: 这一夜我会一直在这儿。
lines.en: I'll be here all night.

lines.zh: 火光一亮，我的翅膀卷了。
lines.en: Fire flares and my wings curl.

lines.zh: 我从半空掉下来，摔在草上。
lines.en: I drop out of the air onto the grass.
Water holds me under.

lines.zh: 冲击把我吹得翻了几圈。
lines.en: The blast sends me tumbling.

lines.zh: 一根箭穿过了我的翅膀。
lines.en: An arrow goes through my wing.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的翅膀停了。
lines.en: The light stops my wings.
No blood to find, and I grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷光照亮我，我一动不动。
lines.en: The flash lights me up and I freeze.

lines.zh: 四周什么都没有，我一直飞。
lines.en: Nothing anywhere and I keep flying.
